Why Suzuki Bikes Failed in India | Suzuki India Case Study

Suzuki motorcycles globally are known for performance and reliability, but in India the story is completely different. In this video, we uncover the Suzuki bikes failure in India and explain step by step what went wrong with their strategy.

When Suzuki India entered the two-wheeler market, expectations were high. But despite launching scooters like Suzuki Access and bikes in multiple segments, they could never achieve the dominance of competitors like Honda, Hero and Bajaj. This video explains the Suzuki India downfall, the mistakes in strategy, and why customers preferred other brands over Suzuki two wheelers in India.
